title: South Park Recreation Center – Outdoor Park Improvements (PRJ21452)
text:
South Park Recreation Center – Outdoor Park Improvements (PRJ21452)
  Project – Final Acceptance – Reallocation of Zone Change Fees
summary: The commission will give final acceptance to the outdoor park improvements at South Park Recreation Center and reallocate zone change fees to that project.

details.action: final acceptance and reallocation of zone change fees
